clips.title: The story
paras: Jorgen keeps watch beside the water at Stormwind's Valley of Heroes entrance. His quiet perch draws people with matters they cannot discuss openly.

Jorgen keeps to the water just right of Stormwind's great entrance. Above him, statues of heroes look over the bridge, while he watches those who come and go below. People seeking information they want kept off the record can find a quiet contact there.
